Leave it to this ever-reliable uptown theater company, then, to come up with the best of the recent takes on Shakespeare’s tragedy of the Moor of Venice.

For its latest annual summertime offering of performances free to the public, Classical Theatre of Harlem delivers a solid open-air revival of Othello at the Richard Rodgers Amphitheatre in Marcus Garvey Park.

cn.t: Classical Theatre of Harlem delivers a solid outdoor Othello that stands out in a crowded season of Shakespeare, with strong performances earning praise despite the open-air venue's challenges.
